notes.account_number: Image shows 8 masking asterisks before the last 4 digits ("********5342"). BDA matched this exactly; LLM's OCR read only 7 asterisks.
notes.transaction_details.description: Each transaction cell has a bold header line plus a detail sub-line (e.g. "DIRECT DEPOSIT" + "Bluewater Solutions LLC PAYROLL"); this fixture combines both lines as the fuller/more complete answer. LLM only captured the header line for each row.
notes.transaction_details.deposits: LLM's last value (382.53) is wrong - that's the Online Transfer row's withdrawal amount, not a deposit (the row has $0.00 in the deposits column, per the image).
notes.transaction_details.withdrawals: Not extracted by either method for this document, despite being a defined schema field - included here as a known gap, not because either extractor got it right.
notes.transaction_details.date: Printed as MM/DD/YYYY ('08/06/2026', etc.); normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here, consistent with statement_start_date/statement_end_date and every other date field in this schema. BDA's blueprint (AWS-managed, not ours) instructs it to always return MM/DD/YYYY for this field. Note extraction-compare's loose-match normalizer only handles a single date value, not a comma-joined list, so BDA will show as a hard miss here rather than a loose match, unlike the single-value date fields.
